contract.single_output: Each scope has its own persistent round shared by clients of that scope; new arrivals join next round; global URLs and existing position preserved
contract.source_output: Source membership is filtered before identity ranking; each source has scoped full JSONL and single-config rotation, independent of every other source and global rotation
contract.mixed_input: Extract plain URIs, full JSON/JSONL, standalone and embedded Base64 blocks, wrapped standard/URL-safe encodings; exact original response and decoded payload bytes remain immutable. URL path case is preserved.
contract.balanced_template: Explicit universal balancer route retains original pool, strategy, fallback, observer and necessary chain tags; collision-free common envelope helpers; no arbitrary server selection
contract.traffic: SOCKS UDP and tcp,udp routing; Vision/Mux UDP443 gates open. No unsolicited Mux: explicit VLESS xudp input maps to UDP-only manager; upstream UDP/QUIC support remains separate.
contract.uri_compatibility: Narrow userinfo space escaping preserves decoded credentials; TLS cs maps exactly; explicit VLESS packetEncoding=xudp uses one UDP stream with TCP multiplexing disabled. Missing REALITY keys remain explicit failures.
contract.smart_output: One canonical cached Smart profile per eligible head; full/single subscription GET randomizes proxy order, full also randomizes profile order; canonical individual API bytes remain stable. Raw and ordinary/source exports unchanged.
contract.smart_envelope: Smart v8 keeps P20 DNS/balancers/socket policy/burst/stats/metrics/logs-off; independent-IP real proxy first for Lib40 route-less RealPing, block retained as explicit leastLoad fallback after copied entries/helpers; all source values retained except existing namespace/socket policy.
contract.smart_admission: Fresh source-owned https_multi_site_verified: two public HTTPS destinations plus TLS-valid Instagram homepage200/206. Ordinary core-valid output and base connection status unchanged. TTL-bounded; no persistent bank; not a claim about app media/carriers or every nested balanced outbound.
contract.smart_single: Durable ready-only rounds, new rounds random, unfinished queue/cycle preserved; each GET returns order-only random rendition with independent IP first. HEAD/prefetch nonconsuming. Canonical profile identity and cache hash distinguished from returned body hash; no-ready503 retained.
contract.acquisition: HTTP/extraction, current source ownership, core-valid output and connectivity are separate. Deletion-suppressed inputs are not ordinary duplicates or successful storage. Explicit source recovery clears only matching retained-response deletion controls, fences old jobs and requires fresh collection/validation.
contract.smart_dns_limit: UseIPv4 retained as requested; pinned core can attempt system DNS on startup/internal resolver failure. Fixture firewall blocks/counts attempts, but exported JSON alone does not guarantee DNS leak prevention. No independent IP yields explicit smart_bootstrap_no_ip.
contract.smart_ping: Pinned Lib40 MeasureOutboundDelay removes routing/DNS/observers and tests default only. Fixed block-first failure; a failed default does not prove full leastLoad pool failure. No universal ping guarantee or APK/carrier claim.
contract.smart_cache: Schema13 validated cache and exact provenance are independent of pending replacements; capacity/source growth refreshes in background, while proof/ownership/settings/version/TTL revocation is immediate.
contract.resource_recovery: Atomic same-plaintext blob replacement, synchronized compiled registries, bounded validated-IP fallback and worker idle polling, scoped UI reads with fetch deadline, unlinked full-export spooling.
contract.smart_splash: Source flag; closed shared SmartPipeline drivers with separate settings/jobs/cache/provenance/counters/rotation/status/token domains and csp worker. Splash identity/candidate ownership takes precedence over ordinary duplicates. No cross-pool filling; ordinary/source outputs unchanged.
contract.smart_ads: One whole fresh Splash head plus ordinary main followers; independent repository/settings/jobs/cache/provenance/rounds/service. Main and bootstrap leastLoad unchanged; terminal Ads dialers chain through main. Missing Ads blocks publication; unsupported chains fail explicitly.
contract.residential: Independent health, attributable Ads egress and exact-IP class. ADS_DIFFERENT is scoped repeated difference with stable paired independent controls; ACCEPTED is independently verified Residential across the entire configured matrix. Both raw and template qualify; equal control/Ads IP can be Residential.
contract.residential_deletion: First suspicion/expiry quarantines. Three spaced fresh owner-bound credible votes, prior accepted scope comparison and an early shared-failure circuit gate global revocation. External authenticated tombstones fence old jobs/backups/manual aliases. No AI authority.
contract.residential_outputs: Two explicitly labelled evidence datasets, each with same-generation JSONL/common, durable per-link next JSON and exact raw.txt. Old strict Residential links unchanged; new Ads-difference links do not claim Residential. Read-time epoch/policy/expiry/journal gate; empty503 and changed-generation409.
contract.raw_output: All-source exact-original raw.txt; one LF between bodies. At serialized admission, captured members must remain eligible/unchanged; unrelated arrivals wait for next request. Invalidations503; old archive.zip redirects.
contract.residential_cores: Official pinned Xray26.11.9 first,26.7.28/26.5.9 bounded parallel fallback. Native TUIC/Hysteria driver uses pinned sing-box1.14.4. One complete raw/template report wins; ordinary/Smart target unchanged.
contract.native_format: Native common output is sing-box JSON with @shenvpn outbound tag, not Xray-compatible JSON; unrecognized/ambiguous extensions and complex routes remain explicit unsupported.
